10330103.speakerName: The World is Silent; No One Speaks
10330103.text: (Xiao says nothing more. Complex emotions run across his face as he looks at the temple to Pervases.)

10330104.speakerName: The World is Silent; No One Speaks
10330104.text: (Sadness, disappointment, relief... They are all there, yet are only a small part of a far larger whole.)

10330105.speakerName: The World is Silent; No One Speaks
10330105.text: (His expression is akin to that of a person who has been out in the blizzard for too long and seen far too much of it before finally gaining a place of respite from the battering snow.)
